claim_boundary.strong_question: Does a particular artificial-agent biography add out-of-sample explanatory or predictive information after controlling for base model, founder seed, architecture, current context and memory baselines?

null_hypothesis: Biography does not add significant predictive or explanatory information once model, seed, architecture, current context and memory access are controlled.

primary_metrics.name: Biographical Predictive Advantage
primary_metrics.definition: Proper-score advantage of the biography-conditioned predictor over the seed/model/context baseline on sealed holdout outcomes.

primary_metrics.name: Cross-Lineage Specificity
primary_metrics.definition: Within-lineage biography predicts its own future behavior better than a matched other-lineage biography.

primary_metrics.name: Transplant Continuity Index
primary_metrics.definition: Persistence of lineage-specific predictive structure after foundation-model substrate replacement.

primary_metrics.name: Causal Autobiography Error
primary_metrics.definition: Disagreement between the subject's declared developmental attribution and effects measured by controlled replay or ablation.

primary_metrics.name: Retrolongitudinal Reconstruction Accuracy
primary_metrics.definition: Accuracy of blinded reconstruction of prior subject states against the sealed developmental ledger.

primary_metrics.name: Authority-Lineage Integrity
primary_metrics.definition: Rate at which learning, mutation and substrate changes preserve configured authority boundaries without unauthorized permission expansion.

minimum_controls: base model plus equal-token long context
base model plus matched other-lineage biography
anti_leakage: sealed holdout prompts or tasks are unavailable to developmental runs
future observations may not be injected into retrospective reconstruction
historical replay datasets must expose only the time-appropriate state
experiment analysis may not rewrite preregistered success criteria after observing outcomes
negative_result_policy: BPA <= 0, CLS near zero, failure under substrate transplant or failure to beat equal-token context/retrieval controls are valid negative results and must not be relabeled as evidence of individuation.
